LightningComponentBundle.description: Text area that blocks emojis, special characters and (optionally) line breaks. Returns the entered value and an error flag.

property.name: value
property.label: Value
property.description: Input: default value. Output: the text entered. Use the same variable for both so the value is kept on Previous.

property.name: hasError
property.label: Has Error
property.description: True when the text breaks the character, line break or length rules.

property.name: errorMessage
property.label: Error Message
property.description: Leave blank to use the default message.

property.name: requiredMessage
property.label: Required Message
property.description: Leave blank to use the default message.
